name: Branch Out fund
summary: Water-company fund for projects that reconnect habitats for people and wildlife, with grants up to £10,000; decisions follow set application windows.

geography.label: Northumbrian Water and Essex & Suffolk Water areas

eligibility.rule: Project benefits wildlife by linking habitats, creating wildlife areas or reconnecting people with nature
Project meets at least two listed criteria
Project benefits include quantifiable and measurable aspects

effort.quote: Applications for the 2027 funding round will open on 1 January 2027 and close on 31 March 2027.
All applications will be carefully considered by the Branch Out team.

eligibility.quote: To be deemed eligible, all projects must provide some benefits to wildlife, by linking up habitats, creating new areas for wildlife to use, or finding ways to reconnect people with the natural world around them.
As well as this all projects must meet at least two of the criteria listed below.
The benefits must include some aspects that are quantifiable and measurable.

after_award.quote: A report on the progress of the project must be submitted to Northumbrian Water annually and/or on project completion (whichever occurs first).
